verdict.rationale: Deel offers a free eligibility check on its immigration pages, run digitally within its platform. Results arrive within 48 hours with a cost breakdown and document requirements. The founders track covers O-1A and EB-1A. However, the check looks like a submit-and-wait assessment with personalized advice from Deel's team, not an instant self-serve qualifier. missing for 10: evidence of an instant self-serve O-1/EB-1 criteria tool, details of the check's structure or questions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
